serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: It seems like your friend is not here yet. You: Looks like it. #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: Uwah~ Did she stand you up~ That would be soooo embarrassing for you~ You: N-No way she would do that… #Annalie_Outside.face.suprised You: …right? #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: Are you asking me? I don’t even know the gal! #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: Let’s sit and order something. Maybe she will come later. You: Ok. Lady Annalie: Since it seems like we are going to wait here for some time, tell me about her! You: I thought that you didn’t want any spoilers. Lady Annalie: Well, it’s this or sitting in silence with you, so I’m choosing the lesser evil. You: I don’t know her that well. We met only a few times. She works in a supermarket nearby. Lady Annalie: Can’t say that this stimulated my curiosity. I was expecting some gang member or a circus performer. You: Who do you think I am exactly? You: Anyway. Just like {f_botName} she has a lot of augments. I can’t tell her that they are bots, so for now I will go with this. You: Since not many people have circumstances such as theirs, I thought that they could easily become friends, but it didn’t go that way. Lady Annalie: Well, your girl is a nice piece of work. She wasn’t too friendly to me at the beginning. Give her some time. You: Right, I thought so too, but Melissa is also giving me troubles. Lady Annalie: Oh man~ You are a magnet for problematic girls, it seems! Be careful or you will end up being stabbed! You: There might be some truth to it. Lady Annalie: What’s that Melissa girl’s deal anyway? I can forgive being rude to you, but standing me up is a different matter! #Annalie_Outside.face.suprised You: She is very defensive. As far as she told us she has some history of harassment, but I feel like it goes much deeper than that. Lady Annalie: Yikes. I didn’t expect this to go so dark all of a sudden. Give me a warning next time! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Closed+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Lady Annalie: Uwah~ Melissa~ I forgive you for standing me up after all! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Lady Annalie: On a serious note though. Sorry, but this whole thing might be beyond my capabilities. You: What do you mean? Lady Annalie: If there’s a serious trauma involved, you should ask for help from a therapist or something. Lady Annalie: Don’t get me wrong, I went through my own share of problems, but I don’t think I’m qualified to help in such matters. I can’t tell her that Melissa is a bot and that a therapist could uncover her secret. You: It’s not like I expect you to cure her. I’m just trying to earn her trust a little so that we could actually hang out and both have fun. #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: Ahhh~ {{wi}}Fine! I will do what I can, but don’t expect miracles! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.SmileClosed+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy Lady Annalie: I can even be extra nice to her if you want, but it will cost you~ You: Y-Yeah, normal nice will be fine I think… #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy Lady Annalie: Oh, come on! It’s not like I would drain your pockets dry! #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: But I can’t say I wouldn’t drain you of something else~ You: P-Please, don’t go so far only because {f_botName} isn’t here. Lady Annalie: I think you misunderstand something. I’m the type of girl that thinks, ‘the more the merrier’~ You: Didn’t you say that you don’t like crowds before? Lady Annalie: Hmmm~ Maybe I did, maybe I didn’t. I’m a very moody girl, you know~ I wish Melissa was here… I don’t know how much longer I can withstand this constant teasing… I’m using all of my mental prowess just to stop a certain physiological response from happening! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww You: S-So anyway, we still didn’t order anything. What are you getting? Lady Annalie: That’s a pathetic way of escaping my barrage, but I will let it slide since my mouth is kinda dry from all the talking. #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Uff…{{Wi}} I managed to change the topic… Still, I have a bad feeling. Melissa doesn’t like me, but I find her not coming here a little uncharacteristic for some reason… She seems like a serious bot. I would never suspect her to break her word like that. Maybe I’m overthinking. It might be some strategy to make me lose interest in her and leave her alone.
